paragraphs: PlotBox sells software for running cemeteries, crematories and funeral homes. The company pitches it as a way to centralise the key functions of a deathcare operation in one easy-to-use platform.

Mapping tools let staff visualise a cemetery layout, manage plot inventory and track burial locations. Scheduling covers cremations, burials and services across multiple locations. Finance modules handle invoicing, payments, receipts and trust fund management. A public-facing side gives families a search tool for finding the resting places of relatives.

Sean and Leona McAllister founded the company, which combines deathcare management software with georectified mapping. It reports over 130 employees globally. Case studies describe work with Calderdale Council on its bereavement services operations. Another covers Liverpool City Council and its cremation services.

quote.text: Sean and Leona McAllister founded PlotBox, which integrates deathcare management software and georectified mapping, transforming the industry.
